sections.heading: The problem is depth, not size.
sections.body:
A pantry is usually deep enough to hold twice what it does. The back half is unusable because you cannot see it, so it fills with duplicates and expired tins.

Glide-outs turn that depth into the point. A designer measures each shelf you want changed — the opening, the fixed shelves that cannot move, the door swing — and every glide-out is cut to that one pantry in our own shop.

items.question: Do you have to replace my pantry?
items.answer: No. The glide-outs fit inside the pantry cabinet you already have. Doors and framing all stay where they are.

items.question: Will they fit around fixed shelves that cannot move?
items.answer: Usually yes. We measure on site and build the glide-outs to sit between the shelves you are keeping.

items.question: How much weight will a shelf hold?
items.answer: Our standard glides are rated to **100 lb** per shelf, which covers cases of tinned goods and stacked small appliances.

items.question: How long does a pantry take to install?
items.answer: Most pantries are done in a single morning. Walk-ins across both walls can run longer, and we tell you which before you book.

items.question: What is the warranty?
items.answer: Lifetime on the glide hardware for as long as you own the home. Shelves themselves carry a five year warranty against defects.
